scope: Timor-Leste medical discovery — UNTL Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: UNTL's official faculty page describes a General Medicine licenciatura and identifies core biomedical teaching in the first two years.
Timor-Leste's official journal records UNTL's institutional accreditation as amended in 2025 and lists 2026 authorisation for UNTL to confer degrees for courses completed in 2025.
A government order describes medical training as six academic years followed by two professional-internship semesters in primary-care and hospital settings in Timor-Leste and/or Cuba.

holdReasons: No current Medicine fee schedule, active intake deadline, vacancy count, complete admission checklist or international-applicant route was located.

The current faculty page does not establish the full current duration or curriculum, instructional language, named clinical sites, accommodation, scholarship/loan support or medical-registration pathway.
Institutional accreditation does not by itself confirm current programme accreditation or international recognition of the medical degree.
nextAction: Obtain UNTL's active Medicine prospectus/admissions call, fee schedule and programme accreditation/clinical-placement records before evaluating a payload.
